dict.string: Lintel controls Music and Spotify and finds the browser tab that is playing, so the island can show and control your media.
Lintel listens to the playing app's audio to draw the live waveform. Nothing is recorded or stored.
Lintel shows the battery levels of your Bluetooth headphones and speakers in the island.
Lintel reads your calendars to count down to your next event and list today's and tomorrow's events in the island.

Lintel shows when a Focus turns on or off, and keeps the alerts you choose quiet during a Focus.
Lintel uses your approximate location for local weather and to tell you when to leave for events.
